/* unicode.c -- UTF-8 decode/encode, the \p{L} \p{N} \s classes, and NFC, as implemented in
 * unicode.h. All lookup data comes from unicode_data.h (generated by
 * tools/gen_unicode_tables.py; do not add code-point tables here by hand). */
#include "unicode.h"
#include "unicode_data.h"

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

/* ---- Hangul algorithmic constants (UAX #15); syllables are never stored in tables ------- */

#define TR_HANGUL_SBASE 0xAC00u
#define TR_HANGUL_LBASE 0x1100u
#define TR_HANGUL_VBASE 0x1161u
#define TR_HANGUL_TBASE 0x11A7u
#define TR_HANGUL_LCOUNT 19u
#define TR_HANGUL_VCOUNT 21u
#define TR_HANGUL_TCOUNT 28u
#define TR_HANGUL_NCOUNT (TR_HANGUL_VCOUNT * TR_HANGUL_TCOUNT)
#define TR_HANGUL_SCOUNT (TR_HANGUL_LCOUNT * TR_HANGUL_NCOUNT)

static int tr_is_hangul_syllable(uint32_t cp) {
    return cp >= TR_HANGUL_SBASE && cp < TR_HANGUL_SBASE + TR_HANGUL_SCOUNT;
}

/* ---- UTF-8 --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

int tr_utf8_decode(const uint8_t *s, size_t len, uint32_t *cp) {
    uint8_t b0 = s[0];

    if (b0 < 0x80) {
        *cp = b0;
        return 1;
    }

    int n;
    uint32_t min_cp, c;
    if ((b0 & 0xE0) == 0xC0) {
        n = 2;
        min_cp = 0x80;
        c = (uint32_t)(b0 & 0x1F);
    } else if ((b0 & 0xF0) == 0xE0) {
        n = 3;
        min_cp = 0x800;
        c = (uint32_t)(b0 & 0x0F);
    } else if ((b0 & 0xF8) == 0xF0) {
        n = 4;
        min_cp = 0x10000;
        c = (uint32_t)(b0 & 0x07);
    } else {
        *cp = TR_CP_INVALID_BASE + b0; /* lone continuation byte or 0xF8..0xFF */
        return 1;
    }

    if ((size_t)n > len) {
        *cp = TR_CP_INVALID_BASE + b0; /* truncated at end of input */
        return 1;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        uint8_t bi = s[i];
        if ((bi & 0xC0) != 0x80) {
            *cp = TR_CP_INVALID_BASE + b0; /* not a continuation byte */
            return 1;
        }
        c = (c << 6) | (uint32_t)(bi & 0x3F);
    }

    if (c < min_cp || c > 0x10FFFFu || (c >= 0xD800u && c <= 0xDFFFu)) {
        *cp = TR_CP_INVALID_BASE + b0; /* overlong, surrogate, or above U+10FFFF */
        return 1;
    }
    *cp = c;
    return n;
}

int tr_utf8_encode(uint32_t cp, uint8_t *out) {
    if (cp >= TR_CP_INVALID_BASE) {
        out[0] = (uint8_t)(cp - TR_CP_INVALID_BASE);
        return 1;
    }
    if (cp < 0x80u) {
        out[0] = (uint8_t)cp;
        return 1;
    }
    if (cp < 0x800u) {
        out[0] = (uint8_t)(0xC0u | (cp >> 6));
        out[1] = (uint8_t)(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu));
        return 2;
    }
    if (cp < 0x10000u) {
        out[0] = (uint8_t)(0xE0u | (cp >> 12));
        out[1] = (uint8_t)(0x80u | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3Fu));
        out[2] = (uint8_t)(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu));
        return 3;
    }
    out[0] = (uint8_t)(0xF0u | (cp >> 18));
    out[1] = (uint8_t)(0x80u | ((cp >> 12) & 0x3Fu));
    out[2] = (uint8_t)(0x80u | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3Fu));
    out[3] = (uint8_t)(0x80u | (cp & 0x3Fu));
    return 4;
}

size_t tr_utf8_whole_prefix(const uint8_t *s, size_t n) {
    /* back over at most 3 continuation bytes to the byte that leads them */
    for (size_t back = 1; back <= 3 && back <= n; back++) {
        uint8_t c = s[n - back];
        if ((c & 0xC0u) == 0x80u) continue;
        size_t need = c >= 0xF0u ? 4 : c >= 0xE0u ? 3 : c >= 0xC0u ? 2 : 1;
        return need > back ? n - back : n;
    }
    return n;
}

/* ---- \p{L} \p{N} \s classes ------------------------------------------------------------ */

static int tr_uclass_range_cmp(uint32_t cp, const tr_uclass_range *r) {
    if (cp < r->first) return -1;
    if (cp > r->last) return 1;
    return 0;
}

tr_uclass tr_uclass_of(uint32_t cp) {
    if (cp < 128u) return (tr_uclass)TR_UASCII_CLASS[cp];

    size_t lo = 0, hi = TR_UCLASS_RANGES_COUNT;
    while (lo < hi) {
        size_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        int c = tr_uclass_range_cmp(cp, &TR_UCLASS_RANGES[mid]);
        if (c == 0) return (tr_uclass)TR_UCLASS_RANGES[mid].klass;
        if (c < 0) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    return TR_UCLASS_OTHER;
}

/* ---- NFC: table lookups -------------------------------------------------------------- */

static int tr_uccc_range_cmp(uint32_t cp, const tr_uccc_range *r) {
    if (cp < r->first) return -1;
    if (cp > r->last) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* Canonical combining class; 0 for starters, Hangul jamo/syllables, and anything absent
 * from the table (unassigned code points included). */
static uint8_t tr_uccc_of(uint32_t cp) {
    size_t lo = 0, hi = TR_UCCC_RANGES_COUNT;
    while (lo < hi) {
        size_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        int c = tr_uccc_range_cmp(cp, &TR_UCCC_RANGES[mid]);
        if (c == 0) return TR_UCCC_RANGES[mid].ccc;
        if (c < 0) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Binary search for cp's decomposition table entry; NULL if cp does not decompose. */
static const tr_udecomp_entry *tr_udecomp_lookup(uint32_t cp) {
    size_t lo = 0, hi = TR_UDECOMP_ENTRIES_COUNT;
    while (lo < hi) {
        size_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        uint32_t mid_cp = TR_UDECOMP_ENTRIES[mid].cp;
        if (cp == mid_cp) return &TR_UDECOMP_ENTRIES[mid];
        if (cp < mid_cp) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* Binary search for a composition pair (a, b) -> c, sorted lexicographically by (a, b). */
static int tr_compose_lookup(uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t *out) {
    size_t lo = 0, hi = TR_UCOMPOSE_PAIRS_COUNT;
    while (lo < hi) {
        size_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        const tr_ucompose_pair *p = &TR_UCOMPOSE_PAIRS[mid];
        if (a == p->a && b == p->b) {
            *out = p->c;
            return 1;
        }
        if (a < p->a || (a == p->a && b < p->b)) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- NFC: decompose ------------------------------------------------------------------- */

typedef struct {
    uint32_t cp;
    uint8_t ccc;
} tr_cp_ccc;

/* Appends the full (already fully recursive, already internally ordered) canonical
 * decomposition of cp to out, advancing *n. out has room for at least TR_NFC_MAX_DECOMP
 * more entries. Hangul syllables decompose algorithmically; anything else not in the table
 * is its own one-element decomposition. */
static void tr_decompose_one(uint32_t cp, tr_cp_ccc *out, size_t *n) {
